episodes.synopsis: A young warrior sets out to rid his homeland of its evil conqueror. In the opener, Lief and his guardian, Barda, embark on their quest to locate the seven gems necessary to free Deltora from the Shadow Lord.
episodes.title: The Adventure Begins

episodes.synopsis: Danger surrounds Lief and Barda in the Forests of Silence as they meet a mysterious girl while searching for hidden gems.
episodes.title: Jasmine, Girl of the Forests

episodes.synopsis: Jasmine leads Lief and Barda to a giant knight in the forest who believes they have come to rob him.
episodes.title: The Golden Knight

episodes.synopsis: Lief heads for the Lake of Tears, but he must first journey though Thaegan's land and solve riddles posed by her guard.
episodes.title: The Enigmatic Giant

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends are chased by Grey Guards because they rescued a Ralad man.
episodes.title: Nij and Doj's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Manus guides Lief to the Lake of Tears by way of his homeland, where they learn a surprising truth.
episodes.title: The Monster in the Lake of Tears

episodes.synopsis: Lief tries to take the gem from Soldeen, a giant monster, but is interrupted by Thaegen, an evil sorceress.
episodes.title: Sorceress Thaegan

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends move on toward the next destination after defeating the Thaegan Sorceress, but Lief realizes they are being followed when the belt signals danger and Jasmine gets a bad feeling.
episodes.title: Tom's Curious Shop

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends are stuck in Noradz, whose residents clean obsessively and whose ruler wants Lief and his friends to stay.
episodes.title: Noradz the Clean

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends must fight their way out of Noradz after escaping from a dungeon, in which they'd been imprisoned.
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends escape from Noradz hidden in a food wagon that takes them to Tom's store, where they learn that the Shadow Lord rules over Noradz.
episodes.title: Cross the River

episodes.synopsis: The group searches for the third gem in the City of Rats and encounters Reeah, a giant snake that guards the city's towers.
episodes.title: The King of the Rats

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends evacuate from the City of Rats. While resting by the Broad River, Lief shares the story of his father and King Endon with Jasmine.
episodes.title: Endon and Jarred

episodes.synopsis: Lief tells the story of his father, Jarred; King Endon; and Queen Sharn, who have all vowed to one day recover the belt's stolen gems.
episodes.title: The Stolen Gems

episodes.synopsis: A festival in Rithmere draws the attention of Lief and his friends, who try to win 100 gold coins by participating in its Games.
episodes.title: Good Luck! Bad Luck!

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends are in danger of missing the games when they are locked in their rooms at the inn and threatened by a stranger.
episodes.title: The Rithmere Games

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends get advice before they compete in the final round of the games.
episodes.title: Test of Endurance

episodes.synopsis: Jasmine is forced to compete in the last round of the games after discovering that some of her opponents have been poisoned.
episodes.title: Jasmine vs. Doom

episodes.synopsis: The Grey Guards attack Lief and his friends as they journey to the Shifting Sands, but help comes from an unexpected source.
episodes.title: The Boy From the Resistance

episodes.synopsis: The Grey Guards continue their pursuit as Lief and the others search for the fourth gem in the Shifting Sands, where they meet Terreocti, the Sand Beast.
episodes.title: The Shifting Sands

episodes.synopsis: Lief loses consciousness after a swarm of bees attacks him, and he receives advice about his quest from his parents while he dreams.
episodes.title: The Heavenly Stone

episodes.synopsis: The sorceress Thaegan is revived by the Shadow Lord and vows revenge against Lief, who continues on his journey. Meanwhile, Jasmine has doubts about Francoise.
episodes.title: Thaegan's Return

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends find Francoise's mother in the palace, but they end up trapped after Thaegan tricks them.
episodes.title: Thaegan's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Lief has a nightmare that reveals a door bearing the Shadow Lord's mark after he and his friends drink from the Dreaming Spring on their way to Dread Mountain.
episodes.title: Meeting Prin

episodes.synopsis: Lief's resolve is renewed after he dreams about his parents.
episodes.title: Kin to the Air

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends avoid gnomes and arrive at Dread Mountain, where they encounter the Grey Guards and a powerful monster.
episodes.title: Vraal Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Prin helps Lief's group defeat Vraal and leads them through the Boolong Forest, where the gnomes seal them in a cave.
episodes.title: Trapped Under Dread Mountain

episodes.synopsis: The trapped group learn they are being observed in the cave, and they devise a plan to trick their captors, escape and find the fifth gem.
episodes.title: The Great Gellick!

episodes.synopsis: The group leave Dread Mountain with the fifth gem but are caught in thick fog as the Grey Guards pursue them.
episodes.title: The End of the Carn Squad?

episodes.synopsis: Dain saves Lief's life when the group is attacked on the way to the Maze of the Beast.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Ols

episodes.synopsis: Lief and his friends are detained at the Resistance hideout until they're cleared of being the Shadow Lord's Ols. Meanwhile, Jasmine decides to leave the group and travel on her own.
episodes.title: Goodbye, Jasmine

episodes.synopsis: Jasmine leaves a secret code for Lief, which he finds when his group enters a town ransacked by Bandits. Meanwhile, their new companion Dain reveals more about himself as they travel to the Tol River.
episodes.title: The River Queen

episodes.synopsis: Jasmine rejoins the group on a river boat teeming with pirates and Ols. After the battle, Lief realizes that some of his friends and his belt are missing.
episodes.title: Pirate Attack

episodes.synopsis: Pirates capture Dain and steal the Belt of Deltora; the group locate a map that leads them through the Maze of the Beast and to the pirates.
episodes.title: The Pirates' Feast

episodes.synopsis: Pirates lock the group in the Maze of the Beast, where a frightening monster lives, but they cannot try to escape until they find the sixth gem.
episodes.title: Maze of the Beast

episodes.synopsis: Dain disappears while Lief and the others escape the Maze of the Beast with the sixth gem. While traveling through the forest, the group is watched by an unknown person.
episodes.title: Sorceress Thaegan Is Back!

episodes.synopsis: Lief's friends are captured by Thaegan, and Lief must consider putting his quest on hold in order to save them.
episodes.title: Mirror of Fear

episodes.synopsis: The group lose a member of their party while traveling to the Valley of the Lost. Harassed by the Shadow Lord's minions, they take another route.
episodes.title: Sorcerer Oacus

episodes.synopsis: The group is swept along the River Tor to the City of Tora, where Dain's footsteps lead them through the city walls even though the Grey Guards are following them.
episodes.title: The Vow of the Torans

episodes.synopsis: In the Valley of the Lost, Lief must play a game to win the seventh gem. While playing, he learns shocking news.
episodes.title: The Valley of the Lost

episodes.synopsis: The identity of the seventh gem's guardian stuns the group, who enter a tough battle to protect the belt and obtain the gem.
episodes.title: The Last Gem

episodes.synopsis: The group must locate the royal heir after finding the last of the seven gems.
episodes.title: The Seven Gems United

episodes.synopsis: Danger awaits the group as they head for the gathering place where the seven tribes must meet to restore the Belt of Deltora's power.
episodes.title: Nevets Goes Wild

episodes.synopsis: Lief uses the Dreaming Spring to investigate a traitorous transfer of information from the gathering to the Shadow Lord.
episodes.title: Battle at Withick Mire

episodes.synopsis: A spy remains undetected among the united seven tribes. Lief is concerned but focuses on the pledging ceremony in hopes that the royal heir will be found.
episodes.title: The Oath

episodes.synopsis: Lief and the others plan to sneak into the Palace of Del to rescue Dain, who has been kidnapped, but they are attacked by an enemy believed beaten in the Valley of the Lost.
episodes.title: The Last Battle of Fire

episodes.synopsis: Lief's group encounters others in need in the Palace while rescuing Dain, but helping them could turn their mission into a trap.
episodes.title: The Seven Tribes

episodes.synopsis: As an army of Ols attack, Lief and the others finally find out who's been leaking information about them to the Shadow Lord.
episodes.title: Who is Dain?

episodes.synopsis: Jasmine makes a personal discovery as Lief comes to her rescue at the castle while being pursued by the Grey Guards.
episodes.title: The Fight for Freedom

episodes.synopsis: Lief must make a choice that may have severe consequences; a battle erupts after the citizens and the Resistance enter the unrest.
episodes.title: Who's the Next King?

episodes.synopsis: The forces of evil try to keep Lief from completing his quest and saving his kingdom.
episodes.title: Battle of the Ak-Babas

episodes.synopsis: Lief must battle the Shadow Lord to finish his quest, after attaining the last piece of the puzzle.
episodes.title: When the Seven Gems Shine
The Pirates of the River Tor
